description: Header file defining interfaces and utility functions for Android vibrator hardware abstraction layer, including service retrieval, callback implementation, and version-specific service access.

classes.name: VibratorCallback
classes.description: Implements callback for vibrator completion, using promise to signal completion.

methods.name: NullptrStatus
methods.description: Creates a status indicating null pointer exception, specialized for different return types.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate vibrator service based on version and name.

methods.name: HalWrapper
methods.description: Template class wrapping HAL service, providing creation and method calling utilities.

methods.name: getHal
methods.description: Singleton accessor for HAL wrapper instance.

methods.name: halCall
methods.description: Performs a HAL method call with fallback to null pointer status.
